description: Get the current BrewPage upload limits (GET /api/limits): request size, site file count, per-file and total size, ZIP expansion, path and name lengths, TTL default/maximum, allowed file extensions and skipped system files. Sizes are bytes. With BREWPAGE_OWNER_TOKEN set: also reach (token|profile) and ownerMaxTtlDays.
name: get_limits
title: Get upload limits
